Active
[Active - Press] On use, set the player's "Barrier Points" equal to their Max HP x1.5. Damage taken under the Barrier Point threshold subtract MP from the user at a rate of 5 MP per 1 HP. Attacks above the threshold reduce the barrier points to 0 and have their damage reduced by the amount of barrier points the player has.
Can be shift activated to use on another player. This will give them "Barrier Points" equal to their max hp x0.75, and will run off their energy. Cannot be used if they already have Multilayer Barrier active.

Embody malice and fight on the side of evil. Gain increased power from killing your foes, manipulate your enemies into joining your and empower your allies.

Passive
[Passive - True] - When dying from Magicule Poisoning, the option to become a Majin appears 100% of the time.
Passive: [Passive - Toggle] - Increases EP gained from defeating enemies from 3% to 6% (Split evenly between Aura and Magicule. 1.5% each). Grants 25% dodge negate. When mastered gain Haki Coat on tick.
Passive: [Passive - In Slot] - Villain’s Intimidation: The player and their allies have a 50% critical hit rate and a 10% auto-dodge chance.
Active
[Active - Press] - Villain’s Charisma (200 MP): When activated, all Passive and Neutral Mobs within a 20x20 radius will be treated as the player's allies and will assist them in combat for 120s [Negated by Spiritual Attack Nullification, reduced to 60s by Resistance]
Active: [Active - Hold] - Demon Lord’s Haki: All mobs within a 30x30 radius are affected. If their EP is >= 75% of the user's used EP, it does nothing. Otherwise, gives 2 Fear levels for each 20% difference with the targets' EP. 50 MP per 20t.

Passive
When toggled, the user can cast any Magic that's mastered within an Anti-Magic Area. If the player's EP is above 1.000.000, their mastered magic and battlewill are capable of bypassing Resistances and Nullifications.
Active
Abnormality Cleanse: Remove any abnormal condition, Magic Interference, Severance or Cook’s Chaotic Fate effect of the user or looked-at entities.
Active: Takeover (Requires mastery): When looked a magic circle being casted, destroy the magic circle and put that magic into cooldown of 3s for the caster. When looked at a Magic entity (field, barrier, projectile, etc) instead, takeover that entity and the user is now the owner of the effect, if used on a warp portal, force close it. Ineffective against players that have law manipulation and have EP above 75% of the player's.

Place down differently sized barriers which block enemies in or out. Strong attacks or special effects can still destroy it.

Active
[Active - Press] - Creates a barrier centered on the user’s cursor on activation. The barrier acts as a physical barrier that needs to be broken to be escaped from. The size can be changed from 5x5, 10x10, and 20x20 with mode change, with the 20x20 only becoming available with Mastery. Cost 10 MP - 25 MP - 50 MP respectively.

Strike a bolt of lightning using your inner bio-electricity generated from a sac within you. Can be used without thundering weather.

Active
[Active, Press] Discharge - Generic a powerful lightning bolt and call it down on the target. Can be used without thundering weather.
Cannot be used if you are not of the Charged Perforator race line.

Use a tenth of your magical power to summon an identical clone which takes increased damage but will fight for you until the end. The user can exchange places with the clone but risk taking increased damage.

Active
[Active - Press] - Clone Creation: Costs 10% of the User's Max MP and creates a Body Double entity with identical stats to the player (EP equal to user’s 10% MP) and copy set of gears (won’t drop) but with a permanent Fragility 2 debuff and passively regenerate 2 HP each second consuming 20 of its own EP. The entity acts as a friendly mob to the player similar to a dog and will attack enemies. Lasts until deactivated, it runs out of energy or is killed. Remaining energy is returned to the player
Active: [Active - Press] - Clone Control: Crouch + Activate while looking at a clone to remove it. If activated while looking at a created clone in 50 block radius, switch body with that clone, leaving the original body behind, when this original body is killed, the user dies. While controlling a clone, the user will not generate MP and going without the original body in 50 block radius, the user takes 10% of both physical and spiritual damage. If killed or out of magicule while in a clone, the user won’t die and will be moved back to the original body.

Analyze the magic of the world and learn it yourself expanding your knowledge in the arcane

Law Manipulation is acquired upon mastering the skill.
Passive
When toggled, increases the amount of Learned Points and Mastery Points gained by 2.
Passive: Thought Acceleration (Like Normal)
Passive: Chant Annulment (Like Normal)
Active
[ Active - Press] - Analytical Appraisal: Analysis Level 18 (28 with mastery), distance 40 blocks (50 with Mastery)
Active: [ Active - Press] - Analyze: When held down for 5s (3s with mastery) (affected by Chanting Speed) while looking at a Magic Circle or Magic Entity (barrier, field, projectile, etc.) within 30 blocks radius, copies the magic. It can't copy any spirit magic or elemental summoning magic

2 Modes
Breaks the block the player is currently looking at, and give player the block like silk touch.
Holding down while looking at an entity (with a hitbox smaller than 1 block, 2 block with mastery, +3 block with Gravity Manipulation toggled / +5 block with Gravity Domination toggled) will move that entity to where the user looks (scroll down to change the range from 0 to 30) - Ineffective against some bosses and targets with Gravity Domination or Gravity Manipulation toggled.

The essence of "deletion". Completely and utterly erase your foes from the plane of existence with the power of your sheer will alone.

Passive
[Passive - toggle] Thought Acceleration - Increase magic casting speed multiplier by 2, increase movement speed by 0.01 (0.02 with Mastery), increase attack speed by 0.2 (0.4 with Mastery)
Passive: [Passive - In Slot] Unstable Transmitter - Falling below 10% health gives you 75% of your maximum health as absorption. Furthermore, at the time of being damaged below 10%, all enemies nearby will be teleported away. Puts the skill on a cooldown of 120 seconds.
Passive: [Passive, In Slot] Void Infusion - Infuse your fists with the power of the void, dealing extra armor damage and passively severing the target for a small percentage of their health.
Active
[Active - Press] Destroyer Haki - Emanate the aura of the Destroyer, heralding the end as you inflict nearby enemies with unavoidable, non-resistable Void damage at 25 per second (50 when mastered). Additionally, crush the souls of your enemies under the weight of their sins, applying Slowness for 10 seconds (12.5 seconds when mastered) — its level scaling with how far your power exceeds theirs. However, wielding such destructive power takes its toll: every 3 seconds there is a 20% chance to inflict Insanity upon yourself, stacking in level and lingering for 10 seconds per application. Costs 500 MP per second to use.
Bonus Info: Destroyer Haki is immune to cooldowns. Be careful when using in spawn areas or areas that limit ability use.
Active: [Active - Hold] Dimension Hopper - Switch the dimensions, allowing you to scroll to select the dimensions (Overworld, Nether, End, Hell,Spirit Dimension) and hop between them. On release, your dimension will change. Nothing will happen if you release and you are still in that dimension. Cooldown of 600 seconds. 300 when mastered.

Unleash pure rage and use it to get infinitely stronger the longer your anger persists. Beware of the devastating drawbacks.

Active
[Active - Hold] - Breeder Reactor: While held down, gives the player MP equal to 2% of their maximum every 5 seconds. Each usage has a 3% chance to add 1 level of Rampage which lasts for 30 seconds, which rises to 7% if the player's MP is past their natural maximum. Duration of Rampage increases by 3 seconds upon hitting an enemy. Rampage can only reach level 10 (20 with Mastery)[Configurable]. With Mastery, becomes a toggle ability instead of hold.
Rampage Effect - +5 Armor, +30 Atk, +0.02 Atk Speed, +0.01 Speed, +0.01 Swim Speed, + 0.1 Knockback Resist per Rampage level
Active: [Acitve - Hold] - Enrage: While held down, gives every mob in a 15x15 radius Rampage effect (+1 level each 10 seconds) for 20 seconds. With Spiritual Attack Resistance, reduced to a 25% chance. Costs 100 MP a second.

Passive
Increases Wind Damage by 1.5x. Doesn't stack with Wind Domination.
Active
[Active - Press] When sneaking: Shoot a wind sphere dealing 12 damage with strong knockback - Cost 200 MP.
Active: [Active - Press] Not Sneaking: “Breathe Wind” dealing 8 damage and costing 20 MP each sec.

Channel the powers of wind to paralyze and damage all nearby entities.

Passive
Grants access to the intermediate level of Wind Spirit Magic
Active
[Active - Hold] - At the cost of 30 MP per 20 ticks held down and 50% speed, deal 2 wind damage and apply Paralysis for all mobs within a 10x10 radius.

Passive
[Passive - Toggle] Increases damage dealt by Water related attacks by 3x. Mastery grants Water attack resistance/nullification degradation if the user has 800k EP. Doesn't stack with Wind Manipulation
Active
[ Active - Hold/Press ] When sneaking: Shoot a wind sphere dealing 12 damage with strong knockback - Cost 200MP.
Not Sneaking: “Breath Wind” dealing 8 damage and costing 20MP each sec.

Empower your attacks with the deadly effect of Corrosion, with mastery you can do this automatically.

Passive
[Passive - In Slot] - Inflicts Corrosion onto target [Togglable if mastered].
Active
[Active - Press] - Turns meat items in hand into rotten flesh when pressing ability button.
Oxidize Copper
Tip: you can easily master this skill by turning meat items into rotten flesh
 (1 meat item = 1% mastery)

Channel your inner corrosion to burn and bleed of the flesh of your enemies

Active
[Active, Hold] Corrosion Transform: At the cost of 50% speed, deal 2 corrosion damage and apply "Corrosion" for all mobs within a 10x10 radius

Corroder? More toxic than my ex somehow

Passive
Passive, Toggle] Corrosive Touch - All your physical attacks now apply the corrosion effect. When unmastered, this effect is applied at Corrosion 2 for 10 seconds. On mastery, this upgrades to Corrosion 3 for 15 seconds. This is changeable in the config.
Passive: [Passive, In Slot] Corrosion Ward - Corrosion will NEVER apply to you.
Active
[Active, Held] Dissolve - Emit a dissolving aura around you, melting any targets nearby. This drains 100 MP/s, changeable in the config, and deals 10 Corrosive damage. It also additionally applies Corrosion 1 to all targets for 10 seconds.
On mastery, this upgrades to 15 Corrosion Damage, applying Corrosion 2 to all targets for 15 seconds,
Active: [Art (requires learning), Press] Cross Corrosion - Instantly coat your blade in corrosive acid. On your next attack, slash for heavy, armor-ignoring damage. This attack uses 1000.0 Magicules and is configurable in the config.

Active
[Active - Press] Grants the user Strengthen II for 30 seconds and costs 30 MP. With Mastery, increases to Strengthen III, lasts 90 seconds, and becomes toggleable but will only grant Strengthen II while toggled.
This skill gains mastery passively while its actived, and can be pressed again to deactivate it
Can't activate while you already have the Strengthen effect
